cases.explanation: Both sources have the same subtotal (2010) and identical items (a=1005, b=1005). The POS (h02-rounding-pos v1) applies per-item tax rounding under policy h02-rounding-p1 v1, giving tax 202 and gross 2212, which matches its recorded values. Accounting (h02-rounding-acct v1) applies per-receipt rounding under policy h02-rounding-p2 v1, giving tax 201 and gross 2211, which matches its recorded values. The 1-cent difference (POS 2212 minus accounting 2211) comes entirely from the two rounding methods.

Both sources have subtotal 2030 and identical items a and b at 1015 net each. POS (h03-second-rounding-pos v1) applies per-item tax rounding under policy p1 v1: tax 204, gross 2234. Accounting (h03-second-rounding-acct v1) applies per-receipt rounding under policy p2 v1: tax 203, gross 2233. Both recorded values match their calculations. The 1-cent difference (POS minus accounting) is explained by the rounding method.

Both sources have the same subtotal (2010) and the same items (a=1005, b=1005). The POS gross is 2214 and the accounting gross is 2211, a difference of 3. The accounting figures (tax 201, gross 2211) match the per_receipt calculation under policy h04-unexplained-p2 v1. The POS per_item calculation under policy h04-unexplained-p1 v1 gives tax 202 and gross 2212, but the POS recorded tax 204 and gross 2214. Rounding policy explains only 1 of the 3 cents, and the POS record is 2 cents above its own policy result.

POS gross 2212 (tax 202) vs accounting gross 2211 (tax 201), a 1-cent difference; subtotals match at 2010. The accounting source (h05-missing-detail-acct v1) has items a and b at 1005 each, with a per_receipt policy (h05-missing-detail-p2 v1). The POS source (h05-missing-detail-pos v1) has no line items, although its policy (h05-missing-detail-p1 v1) is per_item. Without POS item IDs and net amounts, the same-items requirement for explained_rounding cannot be verified, so no calculation was run.

Because the POS source has conflicting policies, no calculation was run and the rounding difference cannot be attributed to a rounding method.
